title: Mentioning marital status or the presence of children may predict slower funding for women.
Female borrowers who explicitly mention the use of past loans may fund more slowly.
Mentioning the duration of the business may predict slower funding for female borrowers.
Providing detailed personal or geographic background may predict slower funding for female borrowers.
Explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
Pitches from women that reference the ownership or goal of acquiring property, such as a house or shop, accelerate funding.
Pitches from women that use terms like 'hardworking' or 'hardworking entrepreneur' tend to accelerate funding.
Pitches from women that reference the use of past loans to maintain their business tend to accelerate funding.
Providing specific geographic locations or settlement names may predict faster funding for female borrowers.
Explicit thank yous to lenders may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
Mentioning environmental protection predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
Female borrowers who mention dreams or future aspirations predict slower funding.
Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
Female borrowers who explicitly state their age fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention children's education or food security fund faster.
Female borrowers who provide detailed personal backstories fund more slowly.
Female borrowers who mention specific local currency amounts or loan counts fund more slowly.
